passages.title: 2023 年台南的登革熱大流行
passages.text: In 2023, southern Taiwan had its worst dengue fever year in a long time. Dengue is spread by a {1}, not by dirty food or dirty hands. In Tainan alone, more than 26,000 people got sick, and over 90 percent of the country's cases were in that city. Most of them happened between July and November, when the weather was hot and {2}. The city asked everyone to pour out the water in flowerpots, buckets and old tires, because this {3} lays its eggs in still water. Workers walked from door to door to check {4} and rooftops. Schools told students to wear long pants and use spray. My cousin lives in Tainan, and he said his class had to check the plants outside their classroom every week. By December the number of new cases finally dropped. Doctors said the cold weather helped, because this kind of {5} grows very slowly when the temperature is under 20°C.

blanks.why: spread by a mosquito「由蚊子傳播」，登革熱是病媒蚊傳染的。monkey（猴子）、turtle（烏龜）、rabbit（兔子）都不會傳播登革熱，後面也說「不是因為食物不乾淨」。
hot and rainy「又熱又多雨」，台灣七到十一月的天氣。salty（鹹的）、bitter（苦的）、lazy（懶惰的）都不能形容天氣。
this mosquito lays its eggs in still water「蚊子在不流動的水裡產卵」，所以要倒掉積水。lion、whale、puppy 都不會在花盆積水裡產卵。
check yards and rooftops「檢查院子和屋頂」，是防疫人員挨家挨戶做的事。spoons（湯匙）、sweaters（毛衣）、cookies（餅乾）都不是會積水的地方。
this kind of insect「這種昆蟲」，指前面說的蚊子。elephant（大象）、dessert（甜點）、mirror（鏡子）都不是昆蟲，也和溫度長不大的說法無關。

passages.zh: 2023 年，台灣南部經歷了很久以來最嚴重的登革熱疫情。登革熱是由蚊子傳播的，不是因為食物或手不乾淨。光是台南就有超過兩萬六千人生病，全國九成以上的病例都在這個城市。大部分發生在七月到十一月，天氣又熱又多雨的時候。市政府請大家倒掉花盆、水桶和舊輪胎裡的水，因為蚊子會在不流動的水裡產卵。防疫人員挨家挨戶檢查院子和屋頂。學校要學生穿長褲、擦防蚊液。我表哥住台南，他說他們班每週都要檢查教室外面的植物。到了十二月，新病例終於減少。醫師說是天氣變冷幫了忙，因為氣溫低於二十度時，這種昆蟲長得非常慢。

passages.title: 新加坡用蚊子打敗蚊子
passages.text: Singapore is hot and wet all year, so dengue fever is a serious problem there. Scientists came up with a clever plan: they raise male {1} in a lab and let millions of them go every week. These males carry a kind of bacteria, so the eggs of the wild females never hatch. Only the female {2} bites people — males cannot bite at all — so the plan is {3} for the people living there. After a few years, the number of this {4} fell by up to 98 percent in some test areas. A large study later showed that people in those areas were more than 70 percent less likely to get dengue fever. The city is now growing the program to cover half of all homes. My teacher said it sounds strange to fight {5} by making more of them, but science is often surprising.

blanks.why: raise male mosquitoes「養公蚊子」，計畫的做法是放出大量公蚊。turtles、rabbits、monkeys 都和登革熱無關，也不會在實驗室大量繁殖後野放。
Only the female insect bites people「只有母的會咬人」，這裡指蚊子。lion、candle（蠟燭）、towel（毛巾）都不會咬人。
the plan is safe for the people「這個計畫對居民是安全的」，因為公蚊不會咬人。salty（鹹的）、cloudy（多雲的）、rude（無禮的）都不能形容一個計畫對人的影響。
the number of this mosquito fell「這種蚊子的數量下降」。whale、shark、puppy 都不是計畫要減少的對象。
fight insects by making more of them「靠製造更多昆蟲來對付昆蟲」，這就是老師覺得奇怪的地方。desserts、mirrors、chores（家事）都不是這個計畫的對象。

passages.zh: 新加坡全年又熱又潮濕，所以登革熱是個嚴重的問題。科學家想出一個聰明的辦法：他們在實驗室裡養公蚊子，每週放出好幾百萬隻。這些公蚊身上帶著一種細菌，使得野外母蚊產下的卵永遠孵不出來。只有母蚊會咬人，公蚊根本不會咬，所以這個計畫對當地居民是安全的。幾年後，某些試驗區裡這種蚊子的數量最多減少了百分之九十八。後來一份大型研究顯示，住在那些區域的人得登革熱的機率低了七成以上。新加坡現在正把計畫擴大到全市一半的住家。我的老師說，用製造更多昆蟲的方式來對付昆蟲聽起來很奇怪，但科學常常令人意外。

passages.title: 台東長濱的藍鯨
passages.text: In January 2020, people in Changbin, Taitung found something huge on the beach: a dead blue {1} more than 20 meters long. It was the first blue whale ever recorded in Taiwan. Scientists from National Cheng Kung University came to study it. They found a fishing net around its mouth, and its body was very {2}, which means it had not eaten for a long time. The news made many people {3}, because this young animal died before it grew up. The team cleaned every bone and kept them all. In 2022, the government said the skeleton would be shown at the National Museum of Marine Biology and Aquarium in Pingtung. Taiwan has nearly 30 kinds of whales and dolphins in its waters, but the blue {4} was not one of them before that day. Our class watched a short film about it. The blue whale is the largest animal on Earth — larger than any {5} or elephant that has ever lived.

blanks.why: a dead blue whale「一隻死去的藍鯨」，二十公尺長的龐然大物。shark、bee、monkey 都沒有二十公尺長，也不是這則新聞的主角。
its body was very thin「牠的身體很瘦」，所以研判很久沒進食。salty、noisy（吵的）、lazy 都不能從屍體看出來，也和「很久沒吃東西」沒有關係。
made many people sad「讓很多人難過」，因為牠還沒長大就死了。sunny（晴朗的）、spicy（辣的）、crowded（擁擠的）都不能形容人的心情。
the blue whale was not one of them「藍鯨本來不在那些紀錄裡」。insect、bee、turtle 都不屬於前一句說的「鯨豚」。
larger than any shark or elephant「比任何鯊魚或大象都大」，用大動物來比較。candle、pencil、pumpkin 都不是動物，拿來比大小沒有意義。

gloss: National Museum of Marine Biology and Aquarium
passages.zh: 2020 年 1 月，台東長濱的民眾在海邊發現一個龐然大物：一隻死去的藍鯨，超過二十公尺長。這是台灣有紀錄以來第一隻藍鯨。成功大學的科學家前來研究。他們發現牠嘴上纏著漁網，身體非常瘦，表示已經很久沒有進食。這則新聞讓許多人難過，因為這隻年幼的動物還沒長大就死了。研究團隊把每一塊骨頭都清理保存下來。2022 年，政府表示骨骼標本將在屏東的國立海洋生物博物館展出。台灣海域有將近三十種鯨豚，但在那天之前，藍鯨並不在其中。我們班看了一部關於牠的短片。藍鯨是地球上最大的動物，比歷史上任何鯊魚或大象都還要大。

passages.title: 豆腐鯊不再上餐桌
passages.text: The whale {1} is the biggest fish in the world, but in Taiwan it used to be food. People called it "tofu shark" because its meat was soft and white. In 1996, Taiwanese boats caught 272 of them; by 2001 the number had fallen to about 100. Scientists warned that this fish might {2} out in our waters. The government first set a {3} on how many could be caught each year, cutting it smaller and smaller. Then came the full ban: since 2008, it has been illegal to catch, sell, import or export this {4} in Taiwan. People who break the rule can be fined or even go to prison for up to three years. If a {5} shark swims into a fishing net today, the fishermen must put it back into the sea at once. Researchers often tag it first, so they can learn where it travels.

blanks.why: The whale shark「鯨鯊」，世界上最大的魚。bee、turtle、monkey 都不是魚，也不會被叫做「豆腐鯊」。
this fish might die out「這種魚可能會絕種」，die out 是「滅絕」。dance（跳舞）、pray（祈禱）、jog（慢跑）放進來都不合理，也不是科學家擔心的事。
set a limit on how many could be caught「限制每年可以抓幾隻」。candle、sweater、cookie 都不能用 set 和 on how many 搭配。
illegal to catch, sell, import or export this shark「禁止捕捉、販賣、進出口這種鯊魚」。bee、mosquito、elephant 都不是這條法規保護的對象。
If a whale shark swims into a fishing net「如果鯨鯊游進漁網」。chore（家事）、noodle（麵）、mirror（鏡子）都不會游進漁網。

gloss: 豆腐鯊（鯨鯊在台灣的俗稱）
passages.zh: 鯨鯊是世界上最大的魚，但在台灣牠曾經是食物。因為肉質軟而白，大家叫牠「豆腐鯊」。1996 年台灣漁船抓了 272 隻；到 2001 年只剩下約一百隻。科學家警告，這種魚可能會在台灣海域絕種。政府先限制每年可以捕捉的數量，而且逐年調降，接著全面禁止：從 2008 年起，捕捉、販賣、進口或出口鯨鯊在台灣都是違法的。違規的人會被罰錢，甚至可能被關最多三年。今天如果有鯨鯊游進漁網，漁民必須立刻把牠放回海裡。研究人員常常會先掛上追蹤標記，好知道牠游到哪裡去。

passages.title: 龜山島的長須鯨
passages.text: In March 2025, people spotted something huge on the north coast of Turtle Island, off Yilan. It turned out to be a fin {1}, the second-largest animal in the world after the blue whale. The Taiwan Cetacean Society said it was the first time a whole fin whale body had been found near Taiwan. A fin {2} can grow up to 23 meters — about as long as six cars in a line. Scientists were {3}, because Taiwan is the southern edge of the area where this animal lives in the North Pacific. Around the same time, a humpback whale was seen in the sea south of Taiwan, and a patrol boat went out to make sure that whale watchers did not get too {4}. Taiwan's east coast is one of the best places in Asia to watch these animals. If you take a boat from Hualien, you may see dolphins and {5} in the same morning.

blanks.why: a fin whale「長須鯨」，世界第二大的動物。bee、monkey、rabbit 都不是海裡的大型動物。
A fin whale can grow up to 23 meters「長須鯨可以長到二十三公尺」。shark、insect、turtle 都沒有二十三公尺長，也不是這段在講的動物。
Scientists were excited「科學家很興奮」，因為這是台灣首次的紀錄。salty、cloudy、lazy 都不能形容科學家的心情。
did not get too near「不要靠得太近」，巡護船是去保護鯨魚不被打擾。rude（無禮的）、thin（瘦的）、free（免費的）放進來都說不通。
see dolphins and whales「看到海豚和鯨魚」。candles、pumpkins、towels 都不會在海上看到。

passages.zh: 2025 年 3 月，民眾在宜蘭外海龜山島的北岸發現一個龐然大物，後來確認是長須鯨，世界上體型第二大的動物，僅次於藍鯨。台灣鯨豚協會表示，這是台灣附近第一次發現完整的長須鯨遺體。長須鯨可以長到二十三公尺，大約等於六輛車排成一列。科學家很興奮，因為台灣是北太平洋長須鯨分布的最南邊。差不多同一時間，台灣南部海域也有人看到大翅鯨，當局派出巡護船，確保賞鯨的人不要靠得太近。台灣東海岸是亞洲最適合賞鯨的地方之一。如果你從花蓮搭船出海，可能一個早上就看到海豚和鯨魚。

passages.title: 三種大鯊魚禁捕令
passages.text: In 2020, Taiwan's Fisheries Agency made a new rule: Taiwanese boats may not catch great white, megamouth or basking {1} anywhere in the world. If one of these animals is caught by {2}, it must go back into the sea right away, dead or alive. People who break the rule can be fined up to NT$150,000. Taiwan had already banned fishing for the whale {3} in 2008 and for the giant manta ray in 2018. Groups that {4} sea animals welcomed the news. They explained that a big {5} has only a few babies in its whole life, so once too many are caught, the number cannot come back quickly. Our science teacher told us that many people are afraid of these animals, but the animals have far more reason to be afraid of us.

blanks.why: great white, megamouth or basking sharks「大白鯊、巨口鯊或象鮫」，都是鯊魚。bees、insects、rabbits 都不是這三種海洋動物。
caught by mistake「不小心捕到」，by mistake 是「誤捕」。fever（發燒）、cough（咳嗽）、chore（家事）都不能和 by 搭配表示「不小心」。
banned fishing for the whale shark「禁捕鯨鯊」，2008 年的事。bee、turtle、monkey 都不是漁業署那年公告保護的對象。
Groups that protect sea animals「保護海洋動物的團體」。pray、bake（烘烤）、borrow（借）都不是保育團體在做的事。
a big shark has only a few babies「大型鯊魚一生只生少數幾隻小魚」，所以族群恢復得慢。candle、noodle、drawer（抽屜）都不會生小孩。

passages.zh: 2020 年，台灣漁業署公告新規定：台灣漁船在全世界任何海域都不得捕捉大白鯊、巨口鯊和象鮫。如果不小心捕到其中一種，不論死活都必須立刻放回海裡。違規的人最高可罰十五萬元。台灣在 2008 年就已禁捕鯨鯊，2018 年禁捕鬼蝠魟。保護海洋動物的團體很歡迎這個消息。他們說明，大型鯊魚一生只生少數幾隻小魚，一旦被捕太多，數量很難快速恢復。我們的自然老師說，很多人怕這些動物，但其實這些動物更有理由怕我們。

passages.title: 鯊魚比樹還老
passages.text: Here is a fact that surprises almost everyone: the {1} is older than trees. Scientists have found shark teeth and scales in rocks more than 400 million years old. The first trees appeared about 390 million years ago, and dinosaurs did not show up until about 250 million years ago. That means this {2} group has lived through all five of the great die-offs in Earth's history. Some kinds have hardly {3} for over a hundred million years. Here is another surprise: a shark has no bones at all. Its body is held up by cartilage, the same soft but {4} stuff inside your nose and ears. The Greenland {5} may live more than 400 years, which makes it the longest-living animal with a backbone. The smallest kind, the dwarf lantern shark, is only about 20 centimeters long — smaller than your pencil box.

blanks.why: the shark is older than trees「鯊魚比樹還古老」，這段的主題。bee、mosquito、rabbit 出現的時間都比樹晚，也沒有四億年的化石。
this shark group「鯊魚這個族群」，指前面說的鯊魚。insect、turtle、elephant 都不是前面在講的動物。
have hardly changed「幾乎沒有改變」，指外形千萬年來差不多。prayed、baked、jogged 都不是動物演化會用的動詞。
soft but strong stuff「柔軟但強韌的東西」，形容軟骨。salty、lazy、cloudy 都不能形容軟骨的特性。
The Greenland shark「格陵蘭鯊」，壽命超過四百年。bee、whale、mosquito 都不是這個紀錄的保持者。

passages.zh: 有個事實幾乎讓所有人都驚訝：鯊魚比樹還古老。科學家在四億多年前的岩層裡找到鯊魚的牙齒和鱗片。最早的樹大約出現在三億九千萬年前，而恐龍要到大約兩億五千萬年前才登場。這表示鯊魚這個族群經歷了地球歷史上五次大滅絕。有些種類一億多年來幾乎沒有改變。還有一個驚喜：鯊魚身上完全沒有骨頭，牠的身體是靠軟骨支撐的，就是你鼻子和耳朵裡那種柔軟卻強韌的東西。格陵蘭鯊可能活超過四百年，是壽命最長的脊椎動物。最小的侏儒燈籠鯊只有大約二十公分，比你的鉛筆盒還小。

passages.title: 鯨魚其實不是魚
passages.text: Many people call the {1} a kind of fish, but it is not. A whale is a mammal, just like a dog, a monkey or you. It has to come up to the top of the sea for air, and its body stays {2} even in very cold water. A baby {3} drinks milk from its mother. There is an easy way to tell the two apart: a fish moves its tail from side to side, but a {4} moves its tail up and down. A {5}, on the other hand, is a real fish, with gills that take air out of the water, so it never needs to come up to the top. That is why the name "whale shark" is so confusing. It is a fish, and it got that name only because it is as big as a whale.

blanks.why: call the whale a kind of fish「把鯨魚當成一種魚」，這篇要破除的迷思。bee、insect、chore 都不會被誤認為魚。
its body stays warm「身體保持溫暖」，哺乳類是恆溫動物。salty、cloudy、lazy 都不能接在 stays 後面形容體溫。
A baby whale drinks milk「鯨魚寶寶喝奶」，哺乳類的特徵。shark、mosquito、candle 都不會喝母奶。
a whale moves its tail up and down「鯨魚的尾巴上下擺動」，和魚左右擺動不同。bee、turtle、lion 都不是在和魚做比較的對象。
A shark, on the other hand, is a real fish「鯊魚則是真正的魚」，有鰓。cookie、mirror、towel 都不是魚。

passages.zh: 很多人把鯨魚當成一種魚，其實不是。鯨魚是哺乳類動物，就像狗、猴子或你一樣。牠必須游到海面上呼吸空氣，而且即使在很冷的水裡，身體仍然保持溫暖。鯨魚寶寶會喝媽媽的奶。有個簡單的方法可以分辨：魚的尾巴左右擺動，鯨魚的尾巴上下擺動。至於鯊魚，牠是真正的魚，有鰓可以從水裡取得空氣，所以從來不需要浮上水面。這就是「鯨鯊」這個名字讓人混淆的原因：牠是魚，之所以叫這個名字，只是因為牠大得像鯨魚。

passages.title: 只有母蚊子會咬人
passages.text: If a {1} is buzzing around your ear tonight, it is a female. Only the female bites, because she needs blood to make her eggs. The male drinks only sweet water from flowers, so he is as {2} as a butterfly. This small {3} finds you by smelling the air you breathe out, by feeling your body heat and by the smell of your skin. That is why you are an easier target after running around. Scientists often say the {4} is the most dangerous animal in the world — not because it is big or strong, but because it carries illnesses like dengue fever and malaria to millions of people every year. The best way to stay safe is simple: pour out still water near your home, use spray, and sleep under a net so that {5} cannot reach you.

blanks.why: If a mosquito is buzzing around your ear「如果有蚊子在你耳邊嗡嗡叫」。bee、whale、turtle 都不會在晚上繞著耳朵飛，也和後面「只有母的會咬人」不合。
as safe as a butterfly「和蝴蝶一樣無害」，因為公蚊只吸花蜜。salty、lazy、rude 都不是在講安全或危險。
This small insect finds you by smelling...「這種小昆蟲靠氣味找到你」。elephant、candle、drawer 都不是會找人吸血的小昆蟲。
the mosquito is the most dangerous animal「蚊子是世界上最危險的動物」，因為會傳染疾病。whale、shark、puppy 都不會傳播登革熱和瘧疾。
so that insects cannot reach you「讓昆蟲碰不到你」，說的是蚊帳的作用。desserts、chores、mirrors 都不需要用蚊帳隔開。

passages.zh: 如果今晚有蚊子在你耳邊嗡嗡叫，那是一隻母蚊。只有母蚊會咬人，因為牠需要血來產卵。公蚊只吸花朵裡的甜水，所以牠和蝴蝶一樣無害。這種小昆蟲靠聞你呼出的氣、感覺你的體溫和皮膚的氣味找到你，所以你跑跳過後更容易成為目標。科學家常說蚊子是世界上最危險的動物，不是因為牠大或強壯，而是因為牠每年把登革熱、瘧疾這類疾病傳給好幾百萬人。保護自己的方法很簡單：倒掉家附近的積水、擦防蚊液，睡覺時掛蚊帳，讓昆蟲碰不到你。

passages.title: 昆蟲是地球上最多的動物
passages.text: How many kinds of animals live on Earth? Scientists have already named about one million kinds of {1}, and that is more than all the other animals put together. Many scientists think millions more are still waiting to be found. Every {2} has six legs and a body in three parts, which gives you an easy test: a spider has eight legs, so it is not one of them. A {3} is an insect, and so are ants, mosquitoes and butterflies. These small animals do huge jobs. Without the {4} and other animals that carry pollen from flower to flower, we would lose apples, mangoes, strawberries and much more. Insects also clean up dead plants and feed birds and fish. So when scientists say that insect numbers are falling in many places, they are not only worried about the insects — they are worried about our {5}, too.

blanks.why: about one million kinds of insects「大約一百萬種昆蟲」，比其他所有動物加起來還多。whales、sharks、monkeys 的種類都遠遠少於這個數字。
Every insect has six legs「每一種昆蟲都有六隻腳」。lion、turtle、rabbit 都是四隻腳，也不是昆蟲。
A bee is an insect「蜜蜂是昆蟲」，後面還接螞蟻、蚊子、蝴蝶。whale、shark、puppy 都不是昆蟲。
Without the bee and other animals that carry pollen「少了蜜蜂和其他傳播花粉的動物」。candle、cookie、towel 都不會傳播花粉。
worried about our meals「擔心我們的餐點」，因為很多食物要靠昆蟲授粉。fevers、coughs、mirrors 和食物來源沒有關係。

passages.zh: 地球上有多少種動物？科學家已經命名了大約一百萬種昆蟲，比其他所有動物加起來還多。許多科學家認為，還有好幾百萬種等著被發現。每一種昆蟲都有六隻腳、身體分成三節，這給了你一個簡單的判斷方法：蜘蛛有八隻腳，所以不是昆蟲。蜜蜂是昆蟲，螞蟻、蚊子、蝴蝶也是。這些小動物做著很大的工作。少了蜜蜂和其他把花粉從一朵花帶到另一朵花的動物，我們會失去蘋果、芒果、草莓和更多食物。昆蟲還會清理枯死的植物，並成為鳥和魚的食物。所以當科學家說很多地方的昆蟲數量正在減少，他們擔心的不只是昆蟲，也是我們的餐桌。

passages.title: 看懂蜜蜂跳的舞
passages.text: When a {1} finds a good field of flowers, she flies home and dances. Karl von Frisch, an Austrian scientist, spent years watching bees through glass walls, and he worked out what the dance means. If the food is close, the {2} runs in a small circle. If it is far away, she runs in a straight line, shaking her body, and then circles back — the famous waggle dance. The angle of that straight run tells the other bees where the sun is, and how long she runs tells them how {3} to fly. In 1973 von Frisch won the Nobel Prize for this work, together with two other scientists who studied animal behavior. Think about how {4} that is: an animal smaller than your thumb can give its friends a map. Scientists today still use his method. They mark each {5} with a tiny spot of color so they can follow one dancer at a time.

blanks.why: When a bee finds a good field of flowers「當一隻蜜蜂找到好的花田」，後面說她回家跳舞。whale、shark、turtle 都不會找花、也不會跳舞報路。
the insect runs in a small circle「這隻昆蟲繞小圈」，指前面的蜜蜂。elephant、candle、towel 都不是昆蟲。
tells them how far to fly「告訴牠們要飛多遠」，far 說的是距離。loud（大聲的）、kind（親切的）、shy（害羞的）都不能說明要飛多遠。
how amazing that is「那有多驚人」。salty、cloudy、rude 都不能用來感嘆這件事。
They mark each bee with a tiny spot of color「他們在每隻蜜蜂身上點上小色點」。mosquito、whale、rabbit 都不是研究跳舞的對象。

passages.zh: 當一隻蜜蜂找到一片好花田，她會飛回家跳舞。奧地利科學家卡爾·馮·弗里希花了好幾年，透過玻璃牆觀察蜜蜂，解開了這支舞的意思。如果食物很近，這隻昆蟲會繞一個小圈；如果很遠，她會跑一條直線、搖晃身體，再繞回來，就是著名的搖擺舞。那條直線的角度告訴其他蜜蜂太陽在哪個方向，而她跑多久，就告訴牠們要飛多遠。1973 年，馮·弗里希因為這項研究，和另外兩位研究動物行為的科學家一起獲得諾貝爾獎。想想這有多驚人：一隻比你的拇指還小的動物，可以給同伴一張地圖。今天的科學家仍在用他的方法，他們在每隻蜜蜂身上點一個小小的顏色，這樣就能一次追蹤一個舞者。

passages.title: 世界上最大的魚
passages.text: Which fish is the biggest? The answer is the whale {1}, and the largest one ever properly measured was 12.65 meters long. That is longer than a school bus. Even so, you do not need to be {2} of it. This huge fish has hundreds of tiny teeth, but it does not bite. Instead it opens its mouth wide, takes in sea water, and keeps the very small animals inside. Its name comes from its size: it is as big as a {3}, but it is a real fish. Each one has a pattern of white spots, and no two are the same, so scientists can tell them apart like fingerprints. The whale {4} swims slowly, often near the top of the sea, which is why boats are dangerous to it. Divers who meet one say the moment feels {5} and unreal, like watching a cloud go by.

blanks.why: the whale shark「鯨鯊」，世界最大的魚。bee、insect、monkey 都不是魚。
you do not need to be afraid of it「你不需要怕牠」，因為牠不咬人。salty、lazy、cloudy 都不能形容人對動物的感覺。
it is as big as a whale「牠大得像鯨魚」，說明名字的由來。cookie、drawer、spoon 都很小，拿來比大小不合理。
The whale shark swims slowly「鯨鯊游得慢」。bee、turtle、rabbit 都不是這篇講的動物。
the moment feels quiet and unreal「那一刻感覺安靜、不真實」。spicy、rude、crowded 都不能形容潛水員遇見牠的感受。

passages.zh: 哪一種魚最大？答案是鯨鯊，有正式測量紀錄的最大一隻長 12.65 公尺，比一輛校車還長。即使如此，你也不需要怕牠。這條大魚有好幾百顆小牙齒，但牠不咬人，而是張開大嘴吸進海水，把裡面很小的動物留下。牠的名字來自體型：牠大得像鯨魚，但牠是真正的魚。每一隻身上都有一組白色斑點的花紋，沒有兩隻一樣，所以科學家可以像看指紋一樣分辨牠們。鯨鯊游得慢，常常在接近海面的地方，所以船對牠很危險。遇見過牠的潛水員說，那一刻感覺安靜又不真實，像看著一朵雲飄過。

passages.title: 鯊魚隊的第一次總冠軍賽
passages.text: The San Jose Sharks play ice hockey in California. For 25 years the team never reached the Stanley Cup Final, the biggest series in the sport. Fans joked that their {1} was always hungry but never fed. Then came 2016. San Jose beat three teams in a row and finally made it to the Final against Pittsburgh. Before each home game, the players skate out through the mouth of a giant {2} head — one of the best entrances in sport. The series was {3} to watch: Pittsburgh won it four games to two, and San Jose lost Game 6 at home by 3-1. The players looked tired and sad, but the city was still {4}. Thousands of fans waited outside to cheer them. A player said later that losing a final teaches you more than winning an early game. The team has not reached the Final again, but that {5} head still waits at the door every home night.

blanks.why: their shark was always hungry「他們的鯊魚老是餓著」，是球迷拿隊名開的玩笑。bee、turtle、monkey 都不是這支球隊的隊名。
through the mouth of a giant shark head「從巨大鯊魚頭的嘴裡」出場。whale、insect、rabbit 都不是聖荷西鯊魚隊的標誌。
The series was great to watch「這個系列賽很精彩」。salty、lazy、rude 都不能形容比賽好不好看。
the city was still proud「全城仍然驕傲」，所以球迷在外面歡呼。cloudy、spicy、thin 都不能形容一座城市的心情。
that shark head still waits at the door「那顆鯊魚頭還在門口等著」。candle、noodle、mirror 都不是球隊出場用的裝置。

passages.zh: 聖荷西鯊魚隊在加州打冰上曲棍球。二十五年來，這支球隊從沒打進史坦利盃總冠軍賽，也就是這項運動最重要的系列賽。球迷開玩笑說，他們的鯊魚老是餓著卻沒人餵。然後 2016 年來了。聖荷西連續擊敗三支球隊，終於打進總冠軍賽，對手是匹茲堡。每場主場比賽前，球員都從一顆巨大鯊魚頭的嘴裡滑出來，是運動界最棒的出場方式之一。系列賽打得很精彩：匹茲堡以四勝二敗奪冠，聖荷西在主場第六戰以一比三落敗。球員看起來又累又難過，但整座城市依然驕傲，好幾千名球迷在外面等著為他們歡呼。一位球員後來說，輸掉總冠軍賽教你的，比贏一場季初比賽更多。這支球隊之後沒有再打進總冠軍賽，但每個主場夜晚，那顆鯊魚頭仍然在門口等著。

passages.title: 菲爾普斯和大白鯊比賽
passages.text: In July 2017, a TV channel showed a race between Michael Phelps, the swimmer with the most Olympic gold medals, and a great white {1}. Many viewers were {2} afterwards, because the two did not really swim side by side. It was too dangerous, so the team filmed Phelps in cold water in South Africa, measured how fast real {3} swim there, and then put a computer shark next to him on the screen. Phelps wore a monofin and a special suit to swim more like a sea animal. He finished 100 meters in 38.1 seconds; the {4} "won" with 36.1 seconds. Phelps said the water was so cold that he could not feel his hands. Scientists who worked on the show said the real point was not the race but the {5} people learned about these animals, which are hunted far more often than they hunt us.

blanks.why: a great white shark「一隻大白鯊」，和菲爾普斯比賽的對手。bee、insect、turtle 都不是這個節目的主角。
Many viewers were angry「很多觀眾很生氣」，因為不是真的並肩游。salty、cloudy、lazy 都不能形容觀眾的反應。
measured how fast real sharks swim「測量真的鯊魚游多快」。whales、bees、rabbits 都不是節目要比較的動物。
the shark "won" with 36.1 seconds「鯊魚以 36.1 秒『獲勝』」。mosquito、chore、candle 都不會游一百公尺。
the facts people learned「大家學到的知識」，才是節目真正的重點。fevers、coughs、mirrors 都不是節目想傳達的東西。

passages.zh: 2017 年 7 月，一個電視頻道播出奧運金牌數最多的游泳選手菲爾普斯和一隻大白鯊的比賽。很多觀眾事後很生氣，因為兩者並不是真的並肩游。那太危險了，所以製作團隊在南非的冷水裡拍攝菲爾普斯，測量當地真實鯊魚的游速，再把一隻電腦做的鯊魚放到畫面上他的旁邊。菲爾普斯戴單片蛙鞋、穿特殊泳衣，讓自己游得更像海洋動物。他游一百公尺花了 38.1 秒，鯊魚以 36.1 秒「獲勝」。菲爾普斯說水太冷，他的手已經沒有感覺。參與節目的科學家說，真正的重點不是比賽，而是大家學到的知識：這些動物被人類獵捕的次數，遠多於牠們攻擊我們。

passages.title: 黃蜂隊的吉祥物雨果
passages.text: The Charlotte Hornets are a basketball team in North Carolina, and their mascot is a big blue {1} named Hugo. The team name comes from history. In 1780, a British general wrote that the area was like a hornet's nest, because the people there fought him so hard. When the team started in 1988, more than 6,000 fans sent in names for the new {2}, and "Hugo the Hornet" won. Hugo was built by Cheryl Henson, whose family made the Muppets. He has won the mascot slam-dunk contest four times, which is more than any other {3} in the league has done. He also tells jokes. When a reporter asked about his private life, he answered that it was "none of your beeswax" — a funny old phrase that means "none of your business", and a good one for an {4} like him. Children at the games often tell him their names, and he writes them on a board so the crowd can {5}.

blanks.why: a big blue insect named Hugo「一隻叫雨果的大藍色昆蟲」，黃蜂是昆蟲。whale、shark、rabbit 都不是昆蟲，也不是隊名。
names for the new insect「為這隻新昆蟲取的名字」，指黃蜂吉祥物。candle、drawer、spoon 都不是球隊的吉祥物。
more than any other team in the league「比聯盟裡任何其他球隊都多」。voice、size、grade 放進來都說不通。
a good one for an insect like him「對他這樣的昆蟲來說很合適」，因為 beeswax 是蜂蠟。elephant、turtle、monkey 都和蜂蠟這個雙關無關。
so the crowd can cheer「讓觀眾可以歡呼」。pray、bake、borrow 都不是觀眾在球場上會做的事。

passages.zh: 夏洛特黃蜂隊是北卡羅來納州的籃球隊，吉祥物是一隻叫雨果的大藍色昆蟲。隊名來自歷史：1780 年，一位英國將軍寫道，這個地區像個大黃蜂的巢，因為當地人跟他打得很兇。球隊在 1988 年成立時，超過六千名球迷為這隻新昆蟲投稿名字，「黃蜂雨果」勝出。雨果是由謝莉·韓森製作的，她家做了布偶秀。他拿過四次吉祥物灌籃大賽冠軍，比聯盟裡任何其他球隊都多。他也會講笑話。當記者問起他的私生活，他回答「不關你的蜂蠟」，這是一句有趣的老話，意思是「不關你的事」，對他這樣的昆蟲來說非常合適。來看球的小朋友常常告訴他自己的名字，他就寫在板子上，讓觀眾一起歡呼。

passages.title: 消失的鯨魚隊
passages.text: From 1979 to 1997, the city of Hartford had an ice hockey team called the Whalers. The team was never great, but people loved it. Its green and blue logo — a {1} tail above a letter W — is still sold in shops today, almost thirty years later. In 1997 the owner moved the team to North Carolina, where it became the Hurricanes. The last game in Hartford was on April 13, 1997. The Whalers won 2-1, and when it ended, the {2} would not leave. Grown men cried in the seats. Players came back out to say goodbye. Fans still sing the old team song at other games, and they still feel {3} about that night. The team later won the Stanley Cup in 2006, but in Carolina, not Hartford. People in Hartford say it is like watching someone else raise your {4}. These days the city has a smaller team, and some fans hope a {5} tail will come back to the ice someday.

blanks.why: a whale tail above a letter W「W 上面一條鯨魚尾巴」，是球隊的標誌。bee、shark、turtle 都不是這支球隊的標誌。
the crowd would not leave「觀眾不肯離開」。fever、chore、cough 都不會留在球場上不走。
they still feel sad「他們仍然難過」。salty、spicy、cloudy 都不能形容球迷的心情。
like watching someone else raise your puppy「像看著別人養你的小狗」，比喻冠軍被別的城市拿走。candle、mirror、towel 都不需要人養。
a whale tail will come back to the ice「鯨魚尾巴會回到冰上」。mosquito、insect、drawer 都不是那個標誌。

passages.zh: 從 1979 到 1997 年，哈特福市有一支叫做鯨魚隊的冰上曲棍球隊。這支球隊從來不算強，但大家很愛它。它綠色和藍色的標誌——字母 W 上面一條鯨魚尾巴——將近三十年後，今天在店裡還買得到。1997 年，老闆把球隊搬到北卡羅來納州，改名為颶風隊。哈特福的最後一場比賽是 1997 年 4 月 13 日，鯨魚隊以二比一獲勝，比賽結束後觀眾不肯離開，成年男子坐在座位上哭，球員又走出來道別。球迷到現在還會在別的比賽唱老隊歌，想到那一夜還是難過。這支球隊後來在 2006 年拿下史坦利盃，但是在卡羅來納，不是哈特福。哈特福人說，那感覺像看著別人養你的小狗。現在這座城市有一支規模較小的球隊，有些球迷希望，鯨魚尾巴有一天能回到冰上。

passages.title: 叫做蜜蜂的足球隊
passages.text: Brentford is a small football club in west London, and everyone calls it "The Bees". The club was started in 1889. The story goes that students used to shout "buck up, Bs!" to cheer the players, and other people heard it as "bees", so the name stuck. For 74 years the club played below the top league. Then in 2021 it finally went up to the Premier League, its first time there since 1947. Fans who had followed the {1} badge all their lives could hardly {2} it. Brentford's home ground holds only about 17,250 people, far fewer than the big clubs, but the noise inside is {3}. The club is also known for being smart with money: it buys young players that no one else has noticed. One writer said the {4} is the right animal for them — small, busy, and able to surprise anyone who thinks it is weak. Even now, visiting fans joke about the {5} waiting for them.

blanks.why: the insect badge「那個昆蟲隊徽」，指蜜蜂。whale、shark、turtle 都不是昆蟲，也不是這隊的隊徽。
could hardly believe it「幾乎不敢相信」。pray、bake、borrow 放進來都說不通。
the noise inside is loud「裡面的聲音很大」。salty、thin、lazy 都不能形容聲音。
the bee is the right animal for them「蜜蜂是最適合他們的動物」，因為小、忙、又讓人意外。candle、cookie、drawer 都不是動物。
joke about the bees waiting for them「開玩笑說有一群蜜蜂在等他們」。candles、cookies、drawers 都不會等著球迷。

passages.zh: 布倫特福德是倫敦西邊的一支小型足球俱樂部，大家都叫它「蜜蜂」。俱樂部成立於 1889 年。據說學生以前會喊「buck up, Bs!」為球員加油，別人聽成了「bees」，這個名字就留了下來。七十四年來，這家俱樂部一直在最高聯賽之下。然後在 2021 年，它終於升上英超，是 1947 年以來第一次。一輩子追著那個昆蟲隊徽的球迷幾乎不敢相信。布倫特福德的主場只能容納大約一萬七千兩百五十人，比大俱樂部少很多，但裡面的聲音很大。這家俱樂部也以用錢聰明著名：它買別人沒注意到的年輕球員。有位作家說，蜜蜂是最適合他們的動物——小、忙碌，而且能讓任何看輕牠的人大吃一驚。到今天，作客的球迷還會開玩笑說，有一群蜜蜂在等著他們。

passages.title: 棒球場上的鯊魚寶寶
passages.text: In June 2019, the Washington Nationals were having a bad season. Then a player named Gerardo Parra chose a strange walk-up song: "Baby {1}", the children's song his two-year-old daughter loved. He got a hit, and the song stayed. Soon the whole stadium was putting their hands together like a {2} mouth — a small one for the baby, a big one for the grandpa. The team began to {3}, and by October they were in the World Series for the first time in their history. Fans wore {4} hats to the games; Parra's teammates danced to the song in the dugout. Washington won the series, and the championship rings they got later have a tiny {5} on them. Parra said he never thought a song for babies would do this. Teachers in Washington said the hardest part was getting their classes to stop singing it.

blanks.why: "Baby Shark"「鯊魚寶寶」，那首兒歌。Bee、Whale、Rabbit 都不是這首歌的名字。
like a shark mouth「像鯊魚的嘴」，球迷用手做的動作。mosquito、candle、towel 都不是那個手勢在模仿的東西。
The team began to win「球隊開始贏球」，所以後來進了世界大賽。pray、bake、borrow 都和球隊戰績無關。
Fans wore shark hats「球迷戴鯊魚帽」。insect、turtle、drawer 都不是這股風潮的主題。
have a tiny shark on them「上面有一隻小鯊魚」，指冠軍戒。bee、chore、mirror 都不是戒指上的圖案。

passages.zh: 2019 年 6 月，華盛頓國民隊打得很糟。接著一位叫帕拉的球員選了一首奇怪的上場曲：〈鯊魚寶寶〉，是他兩歲女兒最愛的兒歌。他擊出安打，這首歌就留了下來。很快，全場觀眾都把手合起來做出鯊魚嘴的動作——寶寶的小小，爺爺的大大。球隊開始贏球，到了十月，他們史上第一次打進世界大賽。球迷戴著鯊魚帽來看球；帕拉的隊友在休息區跟著歌跳舞。華盛頓贏得了世界大賽，後來拿到的冠軍戒上有一隻小小的鯊魚。帕拉說，他從沒想過一首給嬰兒聽的歌會造成這樣的事。華盛頓的老師說，最難的部分是要讓班上的孩子停止唱它。

passages.title: 鯊魚女士尤金妮·克拉克
passages.text: When Eugenie Clark was nine, her mother left her at an aquarium in New York while she went to work. The girl stood in front of the {1} tank for hours and decided what she wanted to be. At that time, few women studied the sea, and some professors told her to teach instead. She did not stop. Clark, a Japanese-American scientist born in 1922, went on to write more than 175 papers and to start the lab now called Mote Marine Laboratory. She dived with {2} for sixty years and showed that some kinds can {3} on the sea floor without swimming, which people had thought was impossible. Her first book came out in 1953, and newspapers started calling her the "{4} Lady". She kept diving into her eighties, even while she was ill. She also kept saying that the animal everyone was {5} of was far more useful to the sea than frightening to us.

blanks.why: in front of the shark tank「在鯊魚缸前面」，決定了她的一生。bee、insect、chore 都不會養在水族箱裡讓她看幾個小時。
She dived with sharks for sixty years「她和鯊魚一起潛水六十年」。bees、insects、rabbits 都不住在海裡，不會是潛水的對象。
some kinds can rest on the sea floor「有些種類可以停在海底休息」，不用一直游。sting（螫）、hatch（孵化）、buzz（嗡嗡叫）都不是鯊魚在海底做的事。
the "Shark Lady"「鯊魚女士」，報紙給她的稱號。Bee、Whale、Turtle 都不是她研究的主題。
the animal everyone was afraid of「大家都害怕的那種動物」。salty、lazy、cloudy 都不能形容人對鯊魚的感覺。

passages.zh: 尤金妮·克拉克九歲時，媽媽去上班，把她留在紐約的一間水族館。這個女孩在鯊魚缸前站了好幾個小時，決定了自己想成為什麼。那個年代很少女性研究海洋，有些教授叫她去當老師，她沒有聽。克拉克是 1922 年出生的日裔美籍科學家，後來寫了超過 175 篇論文，並創辦了今天名為莫特海洋實驗室的機構。她和鯊魚一起潛水六十年，證明有些種類可以停在海底休息、不必一直游動，而人們原本認為這不可能。她的第一本書在 1953 年出版，報紙開始稱她為「鯊魚女士」。她八十多歲、甚至生病時還在潛水。她也不斷說，大家害怕的那種動物，對海洋的用處遠大於牠對我們的威脅。

passages.title: 一本書救了鳥和蟲
passages.text: In 1962, an American scientist named Rachel Carson published a book called Silent Spring. In it she asked a simple question: if we spray strong chemicals on fields to kill one {1}, what happens to everything else? The poison did not stop at the {2} it was made for. It stayed in the soil and the water, moved up through small animals into birds, and made their eggs break too early. Carson wrote that a spring morning could become {3}, with no birds singing at all. Chemical companies attacked her, and some called her an emotional woman who did not understand science, although she was a trained biologist. She was already ill with cancer while she defended her work in front of the government. She died in 1964. In 1972 the United States {4} using DDT, the chemical in her book. Today farmers are taught to protect the {5} and other helpful animals instead of killing everything that moves.

blanks.why: to kill one insect「為了殺死某一種昆蟲」。whale、shark、rabbit 都不是農田噴藥的對象。
did not stop at the insect it was made for「不只停在它要對付的那種昆蟲身上」。candle、chore、mirror 都不是農藥針對的目標。
a spring morning could become quiet「春天的早晨會變得安靜」，書名的由來。salty、spicy、crowded 都不是書裡說的情況。
the United States stopped using DDT「美國停止使用 DDT」。baked、borrowed、prayed 都不是政府對一種化學藥劑會做的事。
protect the bee and other helpful animals「保護蜜蜂和其他有益的動物」。drawer、cookie、towel 都不是動物。

passages.zh: 1962 年，美國科學家瑞秋·卡森出版了一本書《寂靜的春天》。她在書裡問了一個簡單的問題：如果我們在田裡噴灑強烈的化學藥劑來殺死某一種昆蟲，其他生物會怎麼樣？毒性不會只停在它針對的那種昆蟲身上，它留在土壤和水裡，順著小動物進入鳥類體內，讓鳥蛋提早破裂。卡森寫道，春天的早晨可能變得安靜，完全沒有鳥在唱歌。化學公司攻擊她，有人說她是個不懂科學、情緒化的女人，儘管她是受過訓練的生物學家。她在政府面前為自己的研究辯護時，已經罹患癌症。她在 1964 年去世。1972 年，美國禁用了她書中提到的化學藥劑 DDT。今天農民學到的是保護蜜蜂和其他有益的動物，而不是殺掉所有會動的東西。

passages.title: 教室後面的觀察箱
passages.text: Our class keeps a glass box at the back of the room. Inside, we raise one kind of {1} each month, and we write down what we see. In May it was a group of small bees that our teacher borrowed from a farm. On open-class day, families came to watch. Wei-ting's two mothers came together, and one of them asked good questions about how the {2} carries pollen. After they left, a boy asked our teacher whether a kid could really have two moms. She said yes, and reminded us that since 2019 two women or two men have been able to marry in Taiwan, the first place in Asia where that is {3}. Then she said something I keep thinking about: in the box, we never ask an {4} to look like the others before we study it, so we should not ask that of people either. Wei-ting looked {5}. The next week she brought a photo of her family for our wall.

blanks.why: we raise one kind of insect each month「我們每個月養一種昆蟲」。whale、shark、puppy 都不會養在教室後面的玻璃箱裡。
how the bee carries pollen「蜜蜂怎麼攜帶花粉」。chore、candle、mirror 都不會帶花粉。
the first place in Asia where that is allowed「亞洲第一個允許這件事的地方」。salty、lazy、cloudy 都不能形容法律狀態。
we never ask an insect to look like the others「我們從不要求一隻昆蟲長得和別的一樣」。elephant、drawer、towel 都不是箱子裡觀察的對象。
Wei-ting looked glad「薇庭看起來很高興」。spicy、crowded、thin 都不能形容人的表情。

passages.zh: 我們班在教室後面放了一個玻璃箱。裡面我們每個月養一種昆蟲，並記錄觀察到的事。五月養的是老師從農場借來的一群小蜜蜂。教學觀摩日那天，家人們來參觀。薇庭的兩個媽媽一起來，其中一位問了很好的問題，關於蜜蜂怎麼攜帶花粉。她們離開後，有個男生問老師，小孩真的可以有兩個媽媽嗎？老師說可以，並提醒我們，從 2019 年起，兩個女性或兩個男性在台灣就可以結婚，是亞洲第一個合法的地方。接著她說了一句我一直記得的話：在那個箱子裡，我們從來不會先要求一隻昆蟲長得和別的一樣才研究牠，所以我們也不該這樣要求人。薇庭看起來鬆了一口氣。下一週，她帶了一張全家的照片，貼在我們的牆上。

passages.title: 怕蟲不是你的錯
passages.text: I am fourteen, and I am afraid of almost every {1}. If a moth flies into the classroom, I am the one standing on a chair. For years I thought this was something to hide, because boys are told not to be {2} of small things. Then in our health class we learned that fear works the same way in everybody's brain, and that laughing at someone for it is simply {3}. Our teacher asked each of us to write down one thing we were afraid of. Twenty-two people wrote something. Three wrote the {4} they hated most, and one of them was the tallest boy on the basketball team. Now we have a quiet system in our class. If a {5} or a moth or a big spider shows up, whoever is calm about that one moves it outside with a cup and a piece of paper. Nobody shouts. I move the spiders. I still cannot touch a bee, and that is allowed.

blanks.why: afraid of almost every insect「幾乎怕每一種昆蟲」。whale、shark、turtle 不會飛進教室，也不是這篇講的對象。
boys are told not to be scared「男生被告誡不要害怕」。salty、spicy、cloudy 都不能形容人的情緒。
laughing at someone for it is simply rude「取笑別人的恐懼就只是沒禮貌」。safe、free、lazy 都接不上這個意思。
Three wrote the insect they hated most「三個人寫下最討厭的昆蟲」。drawer、candle、cookie 都不是會讓人害怕的昆蟲。
If a mosquito or a moth or a big spider shows up「如果出現蚊子、蛾或大蜘蛛」。chore、mirror、towel 都不會「出現」讓人害怕。

passages.zh: 我十四歲，幾乎每一種昆蟲我都怕。如果有蛾飛進教室，站在椅子上的就是我。好幾年來我以為這是該隱藏的事，因為大家告訴男生不要怕小東西。後來在健康課上，我們學到恐懼在每個人的大腦裡運作方式都一樣，而取笑別人的恐懼只會讓情況更糟。老師請我們每個人寫下一件害怕的事，二十二個人都寫了。有三個人寫下自己最討厭的昆蟲，其中一個是籃球隊最高的那個男生。現在我們班有一套安靜的做法：如果出現蚊子、蛾或大蜘蛛，對那一種比較冷靜的人就用杯子和紙把牠移到外面，沒有人大叫。蜘蛛由我處理。我還是不敢碰蜜蜂，而那是被允許的。

passages.title: 鯊魚寶寶的一百億次
passages.text: In June 2016, a Korean company called Pinkfong uploaded a short video of a children's song about a family of {1}. The song itself is an old camp song, but this version had a simple dance and a tune that nobody can {2}. Children watched it again and again. Parents watched it again and again too, whether they wanted to or not. On January 13, 2022, "Baby {3} Dance" became the first video on YouTube ever to pass ten billion views, and Guinness World Records wrote it down. Ten billion is more than one view for every person on Earth — more than once each. The girl who sings it was ten years old when she recorded it. Schools around the world use the song to teach children how long to wash their hands. Some adults say they {4} it now, but even they know the dance. Not bad for a cartoon {5} family with no words harder than "doo doo doo".

blanks.why: a children's song about a family of sharks「一首關於鯊魚一家的兒歌」。bees、insects、rabbits 都不是這首歌的主角。
a tune that nobody can forget「沒有人忘得掉的旋律」。bake、borrow、pray 都接不上「旋律」這個受詞。
"Baby Shark Dance"「鯊魚寶寶之歌」的正式影片名稱。Bee、Whale、Turtle 都不是這支影片的名字。
they hate it now「他們現在很討厭這首歌」。bake、borrow、pray 都接不上這個意思。
a cartoon shark family「一家卡通鯊魚」。mosquito、insect、candle 都不是這首歌裡的角色。

passages.zh: 2016 年 6 月，一家韓國公司 Pinkfong 上傳了一支兒歌短片，內容是一家鯊魚。這首歌本身是一首老的露營歌，但這個版本有簡單的舞步，還有一段沒有人忘得掉的旋律。小孩一遍又一遍地看，家長也一遍又一遍地看，不管願不願意。2022 年 1 月 13 日，〈鯊魚寶寶之歌〉成為 YouTube 史上第一支突破一百億次觀看的影片，金氏世界紀錄也記了下來。一百億比地球上每個人看一次還多，而且多很多。唱這首歌的女孩錄音時只有十歲。世界各地的學校用這首歌教小孩洗手要洗多久。有些大人說他們現在很討厭這首歌，但連他們都會跳那支舞。對一家卡通鯊魚來說，而且歌詞最難的字只有「doo doo doo」，這成績真不錯。

passages.title: 防彈少年團 Jin 的釣魚歌
passages.text: On December 4, 2021, Jin of BTS gave his fans a birthday present: a song called "Super Tuna". It is a short, funny trot song about {1}, with a dance that uses both hands to copy a fish swimming. He said he wrote it because he really loves fishing, and because catching a big fish makes him {2}. Fans learned the dance in days, and soon the hashtag was everywhere. In the making-of video, Jin is out on a boat and almost catches a baby {3}, which he carefully puts back in the water. Other members of the group joke that he talks about the {4} more than he talks about music. The song was never sold; he gave it away for free. Three years later he put out a longer version, and the performance video passed a hundred million views. Fans like to say that the ocean is the only place where a {5} of a star can be quiet and just be himself.

blanks.why: a trot song about fishing「一首關於釣魚的 trot 歌曲」。baking、praying、borrowing 都不是這首歌的主題。
catching a big fish makes him glad「釣到大魚讓他很開心」。salty、lazy、rude 都不能形容他釣到魚的心情。
almost catches a baby shark「差點釣到一隻小鯊魚」。bee、insect、turtle 都不會在釣魚影片裡上鉤又被放回海裡。
he talks about the sea more than music「他講大海比講音樂還多」。fever、chore、mirror 都不是團員拿來開他玩笑的話題。
a whale of a star「天大的明星」，a whale of a 是「超大的、了不起的」。cookie、towel、spoon 都不能這樣用。

gloss: 韓國一種老派流行曲風
passages.zh: 2021 年 12 月 4 日，防彈少年團的 Jin 送給粉絲一份生日禮物：一首叫〈Super Tuna〉的歌。這是一首短而好笑的 trot 歌曲，主題是釣魚，舞步用雙手模仿魚在游。他說他寫這首歌是因為自己真的很愛釣魚，而釣到大魚讓他很開心。粉絲幾天內就學會舞步，很快這個主題標籤到處都是。在幕後花絮裡，Jin 在船上差點釣到一隻小鯊魚，他小心地把牠放回水裡。團裡其他成員開玩笑說，他談大海比談音樂還多。這首歌從來沒有販售，他免費送給大家。三年後他推出加長版，表演影片的觀看次數突破一億。粉絲喜歡說，大海是這位了不起的明星唯一能安靜、單純做自己的地方。

passages.title: 一支讓計數器壞掉的影片
passages.text: In July 2012, a Korean singer called PSY put out "Gangnam Style". The video had a silly horse-riding dance, and within months it was everywhere. On December 21, 2012, it became the first video on YouTube to pass one billion views. Then something strange happened. By the end of 2014, the number of views had grown so {1} that YouTube's counter stopped working. The old counter could only hold 2,147,483,647, and the video went past it, so the engineers had to {2} the counter and make it hold a far bigger number. Guinness World Records gave PSY a title for it: the first video to need a 64-bit counter. Years later, another song took the crown — a cartoon {3} family. Our computer teacher uses this story in class. She says a {4} like this is not stupid; the people who built the counter simply could not imagine that number. Then she smiles and asks us how many views a video about a {5} would get.

blanks.why: grown so large「數字變得太大」。salty、thin、lazy 都不能形容數字。
had to fix the counter「必須修好計數器」。bake、borrow、pray 都不是工程師對計數器做的事。
a cartoon shark family「一家卡通鯊魚」，指後來破紀錄的〈鯊魚寶寶〉。whale、bee、turtle 都不是那首歌的主角。
a mistake like this is not stupid「這樣的錯誤並不笨」。fever、cough、chore 都不是工程上的失誤。
a video about a mosquito「一支關於蚊子的影片」，老師開的玩笑。drawer、candle、mirror 都不是生物，玩笑就不成立。

passages.zh: 2012 年 7 月，韓國歌手 PSY 推出〈江南 Style〉。這支影片有一段傻氣的騎馬舞，幾個月內就紅遍全世界。2012 年 12 月 21 日，它成為 YouTube 第一支突破十億次觀看的影片。接著奇怪的事發生了。到 2014 年底，觀看次數大到讓 YouTube 的計數器停止運作。舊的計數器最多只能存到 2,147,483,647，而這支影片超過了，於是工程師必須修好計數器，讓它能存下大得多的數字。金氏世界紀錄為此給了 PSY 一個頭銜：第一支需要 64 位元計數器的影片。多年後，另一首歌奪走了冠軍——一家卡通鯊魚。我們的電腦老師在課堂上用這個故事。她說這樣的錯誤並不笨，當初設計計數器的人只是無法想像那個數字。然後她笑著問我們，一支關於蚊子的影片會有幾次觀看。

passages.title: 蚊子笑話三則
passages.text: My uncle thinks he is funny. Here are three of his jokes about the {1}. First: Why is the mosquito a good singer? Because it has such a small {2} and still wakes you up. Second: A boy says, "There is a {3} in my room and I cannot sleep." His mother says, "Just ignore it." The boy says, "I tried, but it keeps bringing friends." Third, and this one is the worst: What do you call an {4} that cannot stop talking about its trip to your arm? A blood blogger. My little sister laughs at all of them. I only laugh at the second one, because last summer it really {5} to me. My uncle says a joke is like a bite: if it still bothers you the next day, it worked.

blanks.why: his jokes about the mosquito「他關於蚊子的笑話」。whale、shark、turtle 都不是這三則笑話的主題。
such a small voice「這麼小的聲音」，蚊子在耳邊叫得很小聲卻把人叫醒。drawer、chore、fever 都不能形容蚊子發出的聲音。
There is a mosquito in my room「我房間裡有一隻蚊子」，所以睡不著。cookie、candle、towel 都不會讓人睡不著還揪朋友來。
an insect that cannot stop talking「一隻講不停的昆蟲」。elephant、mirror、spoon 都不是在講蚊子的笑話角色。
it really happened to me「這真的發生在我身上」。baked、borrowed、prayed 都接不上這個句子。

passages.zh: 我叔叔覺得自己很幽默。這裡是他三則關於蚊子的笑話。第一則：為什麼蚊子是好歌手？因為牠的聲音那麼小，卻還是把你叫醒。第二則：一個男孩說：「我房間裡有一隻蚊子，我睡不著。」媽媽說：「不要理牠就好。」男孩說：「我試過了，可是牠一直帶朋友來。」第三則，也是最糟的一則：一隻講不停、一直說牠去你手臂旅行的昆蟲，要叫什麼？血液部落客。我妹妹每一則都笑。我只笑第二則，因為去年夏天這真的發生在我身上。我叔叔說，笑話就像被咬一口：如果隔天還讓你覺得癢，那就成功了。

passages.title: 海裡的冷笑話
passages.text: My classmate Ruo-han collects bad ocean jokes. Here are my favorites. Why did the {1} cross the reef? To get to the other tide. What do you call a {2} that talks too much? A blubbermouth. Why was the little fish {3}? Because all its friends were a bit shellfish. And the last one: a {4} walks into a flower shop and says, "I would like something sweet, and please do not tell my boss." Ruo-han tells these jokes at lunch with a completely straight face, which somehow makes them even more {5}. Our English teacher likes them because every one depends on two words that sound the same. She says if you can hear the joke, your ears are learning. Last week she let Ruo-han put one on the board every Monday. Somebody has already asked for a whole week of shark jokes.

blanks.why: Why did the shark cross the reef?「鯊魚為什麼要穿過礁岩？」諧音笑話 tide/side。bee、chore、drawer 都不會穿過礁岩。
a whale that talks too much「話太多的鯨魚」，blubbermouth 是拿 blubber（鯨脂）玩 blabbermouth（大嘴巴）的諧音。candle、cookie、mirror 都不會說話。
Why was the little fish sad?「小魚為什麼難過？」shellfish 玩 selfish 的諧音。salty、cloudy、spicy 都不能形容魚的心情。
a bee walks into a flower shop「一隻蜜蜂走進花店」。towel、spoon、fever 都不會走進花店買甜的東西。
makes them even more interesting「讓笑話更有意思」。salty、lazy、thin 都和「板著臉講笑話」的效果無關。

passages.zh: 我同學若涵收集爛的海洋笑話。這些是我最喜歡的幾則。鯊魚為什麼要穿過礁岩？為了到另一邊的潮水（other tide 諧音 other side）。話太多的鯨魚要叫什麼？blubbermouth（鯨脂嘴，諧音大嘴巴）。小魚為什麼難過？因為牠的朋友都有點 shellfish（貝類，諧音自私）。最後一則：一隻蜜蜂走進花店說：「我想要點甜的，請不要告訴我老闆。」若涵在午餐時間板著一張臉講這些笑話，不知為什麼反而更有意思。我們的英文老師很喜歡，因為每一則都靠兩個發音相同的字。她說如果你聽得懂笑話，你的耳朵就在學習。上週她讓若涵每個星期一在黑板上寫一則。已經有人要求來一整週的鯊魚笑話了。

passages.title: 花蓮賞鯨的早晨
passages.text: If you want to see a {1} in Taiwan, go east. Boats leave the harbor in Hualien early in the morning, when the sea is still {2}. The guide tells everyone the rules first: stay seated, keep your voice down, and never throw anything into the water. Then the boat goes out, and everybody watches. Most mornings you see dolphins — sometimes a hundred of them, jumping beside the boat. A big {3} is rarer, so when someone shouts and points, the whole boat turns. My father took me last summer. We saw a tail go up and then down, slowly, about fifty meters away, and nobody said anything for a while. On the way back, the guide explained that these animals are in {4} because of fishing nets and plastic bags. He said watching them is fine, but following them too closely is not. I had come to see a {5}, and I went home thinking about garbage.

blanks.why: see a whale in Taiwan「在台灣看鯨魚」。bee、insect、drawer 都不需要搭船出海看。
the sea is still calm「海還很平靜」。salty、lazy、rude 都不是清晨出海的理由。
A big whale is rarer「大鯨魚比較少見」，和海豚相比。cookie、towel、spoon 都不會在海上出現。
these animals are in trouble「這些動物處境堪憂」。fever、cough、chore 都不能和 in 搭配表示處境。
I had come to see a whale「我是來看鯨魚的」。mosquito、bee、candle 都不是那趟出海的目的。

passages.zh: 如果你想在台灣看鯨魚，就往東邊去。船在清晨從花蓮的港口出發，那時海還很平靜。導覽員會先說規則：坐好、放低音量、絕對不要把東西丟進海裡。然後船出海，大家一起看。大多數的早晨你會看到海豚，有時上百隻在船邊跳躍。大鯨魚比較少見，所以當有人喊出聲、用手指著，整船的人都會轉過去。去年夏天爸爸帶我去。我們看到一條尾巴慢慢升起又落下，大約五十公尺遠，有一陣子沒有人說話。回程時，導覽員說這些動物的處境很不好，因為漁網和塑膠袋。他說觀看沒問題，但跟得太近就不行。我本來是去看鯨魚的，回家時想的卻是垃圾。

passages.title: 養蜂人阿公
passages.text: My grandfather keeps bees on a hill in Nantou. He has twelve wooden boxes, and he opens them in the early afternoon, when most of the workers are out at the flowers. He wears a white suit and a hat with a net, but he wears no {1}. He says a calm hand is never stung. I do not believe him, but in three years I have never seen a {2} go after him. He showed me how to look for the queen, who is longer than the others and moves slowly while the rest of the {3} walk around her. Grandfather sells his honey at a stand by the road. He always leaves some in the box for the {4}, because, he says, they did not work all spring for us. He also complains that the weather has changed and the flowers open at the wrong times now. Last month a farmer nearby stopped spraying his field, and Grandfather was so {5} that he gave him two jars.

blanks.why: he wears no gloves「他不戴手套」。candles、drawers、spoons 都不是養蜂人會穿戴的東西。
never seen a bee go after him「從沒看到蜜蜂去追他」。chore、mirror、fever 都不會追人。
the rest of the insects walk around her「其他昆蟲繞著她走」，指蜂群。candles、drawers、spoons 都不會走動。
leaves some in the box for the bees「留一些在箱子裡給蜜蜂」。cookies、towels、fevers 都不是要留蜂蜜給的對象。
Grandfather was so glad「阿公非常開心」，因為鄰居不再噴藥。spicy、crowded、rude 都不能形容他的反應。

passages.zh: 我阿公在南投的山上養蜂。他有十二個木箱，下午早一點的時候打開，那時大部分的工蜂都出去採花了。他穿白色的工作服、戴有網子的帽子，但他不戴手套。他說手穩的人不會被螫。我不相信，可是三年來我從沒看過有蜜蜂去追他。他教我怎麼找蜂王：她比別的蜂長，動作慢，其他蜜蜂繞著她走。阿公在路邊的攤子賣蜂蜜。他總會在箱子裡留一些給蜜蜂，因為他說，牠們辛苦一整個春天不是為了我們。他也抱怨天氣變了，現在花開的時間都不對。上個月附近有個農夫不再噴藥，阿公高興得送了他兩罐蜂蜜。

passages.title: 我們在才藝表演跳了釣魚舞
passages.text: For our school talent show, six of us decided to dance to "Super Tuna", the trot song that Jin of BTS gave his fans for free. We chose it because the moves are easy and because nobody else would pick a song about fishing. We practiced in the back of the classroom every lunch for three weeks. Ching-wen made us six paper {1} to hold, and Yu-hao painted a huge {2} on the backdrop, which was not in the song at all but looked great. On the day, the sound started two seconds late and I turned the wrong way, so for a moment I was the only one facing the audience. Everyone {3}, and then the whole hall clapped along. We did not win. The band that played after us was better. But our homeroom teacher recorded the whole thing, and now when we are {4} before a test, someone plays it. Yu-hao says our next song will be about a {5}, because he has already drawn one.

blanks.why: six paper sharks to hold「六隻紙做的鯊魚拿在手上」。candles、drawers、spoons 都不是她為舞蹈做的道具。
painted a huge whale on the backdrop「在布景上畫了一隻大鯨魚」。chore、fever、drawer 都不會被畫在舞台布景上當圖案。
Everyone laughed「大家都笑了」，因為我轉錯方向。baked、borrowed、prayed 都接不上這個情境。
when we are tired before a test「考試前我們很累的時候」。salty、cloudy、spicy 都不能形容人的狀態。
our next song will be about a shark「下一首歌會跟鯊魚有關」。candle、towel、spoon 都不是他畫的動物。

passages.zh: 為了學校的才藝表演，我們六個人決定跳〈Super Tuna〉，就是防彈少年團 Jin 免費送給粉絲的那首 trot 歌。我們選它是因為舞步簡單，而且不會有別人挑一首關於釣魚的歌。我們連續三週每天午休在教室後面練習。靜文幫我們做了六隻紙鯊魚拿在手上，宇豪在舞台布景上畫了一隻超大的鯨魚，歌裡根本沒有提到，但看起來很棒。表演那天，音樂慢了兩秒才出來，我轉錯方向，所以有一瞬間只有我面對觀眾。大家都笑了，接著全場跟著拍手。我們沒有得獎，後面那個樂團表現更好。但我們的班導把整段錄了下來，現在考試前大家很累的時候，就會有人放出來看。宇豪說我們下一首歌要跟鯊魚有關，因為他已經先畫好了。
